models.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2 Multimodal Embedding Model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open 740M parameter multimodal embedding model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space for consumer hardware.
models.why: It offers low-latency semantic representations for on-device computer vision and multimodal retrieval applications.

models.title: Community Quantizations of Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Released for Local Use
models.summary: This repository provides GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation using ComfyUI.
models.why: It enables efficient local execution of vision models on consumer hardware and Apple Silicon.

models.title: DeepSeek Releases V4.1-Flash-1017 Update with Visual and Reasoning Improvements
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update delivering improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing execution time and output length.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: OpenMOSS Team Introduces MOSS-Image-SFT Fine-Tuned Generation Model
models.summary: MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned text-to-image model supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for text placement and object arrangement.
models.why: It provides better text grouping and structured layouts for image generation pipelines.

models.title: Liquid AI Introduces LFM2.5-24B-A2B On-Device Reasoning Model
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters built for fast, private agents, featuring competitive agentic performance and efficient on-device inference.
models.why: It delivers low-latency reasoning capabilities suited for edge deployments.

models.title: OpenMOSS Team Releases MOSS-Image-Base Text-to-Image Model
models.summary: MOSS-Image-Base is the base text-to-image model in the MOSS-Image family supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for controlling object arrangement.
models.why: It serves as the base architecture for layout-controlled image synthesis.
